units.title: First Conversations
units.description: Start with warm hellos, goodbyes, and the first question Rachel will hear.

lessons.title: Greetings
lessons.summary: Say hello, thank you, and goodbye in simple spoken Bengali.

grammar.notes: Practice the phrase as a sound-first chunk. Focus on meaning and natural recall, not grammar charts or memorized rules.

exercises.prompt: Listen first. Then tap what you hear.
Type the romanized Bengali for “thank you”.

exercises.answer: nomoskar -> hello / respectful greeting, hello -> hello, dhonnobad -> thank you, abar dekha hobe -> see you again

exercises.prompt: Choose the Bengali for “see you again”.
